pattern: ちゃいけない・じゃいけない
purpose: State a prohibition in everyday speech.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
て-form: ては → ちゃ; では → じゃ; add いけない.
You must not drink that water.
You must not forget your promise.
formation: て-form: ては → ちゃ; では → じゃ; add いけない.
restrictions: Use with people who accept a direct, informal warning.
mistake: ちゃ is a contraction, not an ending added to the dictionary form.
